items.titleZh: 中科大联合荷兰团队：乙酸解聚实现废弃 PET 塑料闭环升级回收
items.titleEn: USTC and TU Delft achieve closed-loop PET recycling via acetic acid depolymerization
items.summary: 中国科学技术大学傅尧、邓晋团队联合荷兰乌得勒支大学沈莉教授，在《自然 - 通讯》发表成果，提出了一种利用乙酸化学解聚实现废弃 PET 塑料升级回收的新工艺。该研究针对当前 PET 回收主要面临降级回收（如饮料瓶变纺织品）及高成本、低效率的痛点，创新性地采用乙酸作为溶剂，通过熔融 - 溶解 - 析出的过程，将废弃 PET 直接转化为高纯度对苯二甲酸（PTA）和高附加值溶剂乙二醇二乙酸酯（GBE）。这一技术路径不仅实现了从废弃塑料到基础化工原料的“升级回收”，还构建了“解聚 - 聚合”闭环循环体系。生命周期评估显示，相比化石资源制 PET 工艺，该方案不可再生能源消耗降低 70%，全球变暖潜力降低 40% 以上，是目前 PET 化学回收中环境效益最优的方法。该成果为 rPET 和 PPWR（可再生聚酯）产业链提供了低成本、高耐受性的原料来源，有助于品牌商实现 EPR（生产者责任延伸）合规及 G

items.titleZh: 欧盟PPWR指南发布：2026年8月12日生效，明确包装合规红线
items.titleEn: EU PPWR Guidelines Released: Compliance Deadlines and Rules Set for 2026
items.summary: 欧盟委员会正式发布《包装和包装废弃物法规》（PPWR）实施指南草案，标志着欧盟包装监管从原则性立法转向精细化执法。该指南明确了2026年8月12日为关键生效节点，对跨境卖家及品牌商提出严苛要求。核心内容包括：1）界定“包装”范围，明确塑料含量≥5%的复合包装受一次性塑料禁令约束；2）厘清“制造商”与“生产者”责任，品牌商需对物理合规（如可回收性）负终极责任，而首次投放市场的经营者需履行延伸生产者责任（EPR）；3）设定有害物质限值，2026年起食品接触包装PFAS浓度严格受限（单体≤25ppb）；4）规划可回收性分阶段目标，2030年需达C级（≥70%），2038年仅允许A/B级包装上市；5）要求2030年起运输包装重复使用率达40%。对产业链而言，原料端需加速布局PCR（消费后再生塑料）及rPET供应链以满足再生含量目标；加工端需优化设计以降低空隙率并提升可回收性；品牌商需立即完成EPR
items.summaryEn: The European Commission officially released the draft implementation guidelines for the "Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation" (PPWR), marking a shift from principle-based legislation to refined enforcement in EU packaging regulation. The guidelines clarify August 12, 2026, as the key effective date, imposing stringent requirements on cross-border sellers and brand owners. Key contents include: 1) defining the scope of "packaging," specifying that composite packaging with ≥5% plastic content is subject to the single-use plastic ban; 2) clarifying the responsibilities of "manufacturers" and "producers," with brand owners bearing ultimate responsibility for physical compliance (such as recyclability), while operators introducing products to the market for the first time must fulfill extended producer responsibility (EPR); 3) setting limits for hazardous substances, with PFAS concentrations in food contact packaging strictly limited from 2026 (monomers ≤25ppb); 4) planning phased targets for recyclability, aiming for C-grade (≥70%) by 2030, with only A/B-grade packaging allowed on the market by 2038; 5) requiring a 40% reuse rate for transport packaging from 2030. For the supply chain, the raw material end needs to accelerate the layout of PCR (post-consumer recycled plastic) and rPET supply chains to meet recycling content goals; the processing end needs to optimize design to reduce void ratio and enhance recyclability; brand owners must immediately complete EPR.

items.summaryEn: Recently, a research team at the University of Cambridge has made a breakthrough, developing a new method to convert plastic waste into clean hydrogen gas. The core innovation of this technology lies in utilizing sunlight as an energy source and combining acidic substances extracted from used car batteries as a catalyst to achieve efficient decomposition of plastic waste and hydrogen generation. items.summary: 欧盟《包装和包装废弃物法规》（PPWR）作为“绿色新政”核心支柱，于 2026 年 8 月 12 日起全面取代旧指令，对全球包装产业链产生颠覆性影响。新规核心在于强制最小化“关注物质”（SoCs）并设定严格的全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）浓度限值。对于食品包装，PFAS 总量不得超过 250 ppb，单一 PFAS 不得超过 25 ppb，且该限值适用于所有包装组件（含油墨、涂层、胶水），再生材料包装不享有任何豁免。合规检测需采用热裂解 - 气相色谱/质谱（Py-GC/MS）等靶向分析方法，总氟含量超过 50 ppm 的样品将面临严格审查。此外，PPWR 引入了新的塑料含量阈值机制：含塑料≥5% 的包装若属于一次性塑料禁令范围，将从 2030 年起被禁止使用，这与原《一次性塑料指令》无最低阈值豁免的规则形成显著差异。法规还明确了“生产企业”与“生产者”的法律责任划分，要求企业编制符合性声明

items.summaryEn: On August 12, 2026, the EU's "Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation" (PPWR) will be fully enforced across its 27 member states, marking a unprecedented compliance red line in the food contact packaging sector. items.title: EU's AI Act: Delays and Revisions Spark Controversy
items.titleZh: 欧盟 AI 法案修订：关键条款延期，生物识别监管强化
items.titleEn: EU AI Act Revised: Key Rules Delayed, Biometric Oversight Tightened
items.summary:
欧盟人工智能法案（AI Act）在历经九小时激烈谈判后达成妥协，标志着该法规制定进入关键转折期。尽管立法者试图建立针对高风险 AI 应用的严格规则，但面对大型科技公司的游说及关于行政繁琐（red tape）和市场竞争的担忧，法案内容发生了实质性调整。原定于近期实施的高风险 AI 系统监管规则被推迟，具体实施时间表将延至 2027 年 12 月。这一调整主要涉及生物识别（biometrics）和执法领域的高风险应用，引发了业界对监管力度削弱的担忧。

然而，在整体节奏放缓的同时，法案在特定伦理领域采取了更为严厉的措施。针对由 xAI 聊天机器人生成的未经授权的显性图像，新法案明确予以禁止，并计划于 12 月前生效。这一举措旨在保护弱势群体免受 AI 生成内容的侵害，体现了欧盟在 AI 治理中“安全优先”的立场，同时也回应了公众对 AI 滥用风险的关切。

items.titleEn: 2026 Polyolefin Chemical Recycling Report: Policy Shift & Tech Breakthroughs
items.summary: 2026 年被视为聚烯烃化学循环的转折之年，北京国嘉基业信息咨询有限公司联合中国合成树脂协会塑料循环利用分会发布《2026 年聚烯烃化学循环发展报告（征求意见稿）》，旨在凝聚行业智慧。报告指出，2025 年中国聚烯烃产能达 8809.5 万吨，传统物理回收面临分选难、性能衰减大等瓶颈，而热裂解、催化裂解等化学循环技术正从概念迈向规模化商业。政策层面，《中华人民共和国生态环境法典》将首次从法律层面确认废塑料作为“再生材料来源”的合法地位，并明确到 2030 年再生塑料年产量超 1950 万吨的目标。技术方面，惠城环保“一步法”催化裂解技术碳氢总收率超 92%，华东理工大学非晶 - 晶粒复合催化剂使 LDPE 裂解气体收率达 92.79%。市场方面，预计 2026 年底中国废塑料化学回收年处理能力有望突破 300 万吨，化学回收市场规模突破 150 亿元。报告面向全行业公开征求意见，重点聚焦技
items.summaryEn: 2026 is seen as a turning point for the olefin chemical recycling cycle. Beijing Guojiajiye Information Consulting Co., Ltd., in collaboration with the Plastic Recycling Branch of the China Synthetic Resin Association, released the "2026 Olefin Chemical Recycling Development Report (Consultation Draft)" to gather industry wisdom. The report indicates that China's olefin production capacity reached 88.095 million tons in 2025, with traditional physical recycling facing challenges such as difficult sorting and significant performance degradation. Meanwhile, chemical recycling technologies like thermal cracking and catalytic cracking are moving from concept to large-scale commercialization. On the policy front, the "Environmental Protection Code of the People's Republic of China" will for the first time legally confirm the status of waste plastics as "regenerated material sources," and clearly set a goal of over 19.5 million tons of recycled plastic production by 2030. Technically, Huicheng Environmental's "one-step" catalytic cracking technology achieves a total hydrocarbon yield over 92%, and the non-crystalline-grain composite catalyst from East China University of Science and Technology achieves an LDPE cracking gas yield of 92.79%. In the market, it is expected that by the end of 2026, China's annual chemical recycling capacity for waste plastics will exceed 3 million tons, with the chemical recycling market size surpassing 15 billion yuan. items.title: 包装可回收性评估及再生料含量测试认证服务
items.titleZh: 欧盟新规强制包装再生料：2030 年 PET 达 30%、塑料瓶达 30%
items.titleEn: EU Mandates 30% Recycled Content in PET and Plastic Bottles by 2030
items.summary: 随着全球塑料循环经济政策趋严，欧盟于 2030 年 1 月 1 日起实施强制性包装再生料使用标准，要求 PET 接触敏感包装再生料含量不低于 30%，一次性塑料饮料瓶不低于 30%，其他塑料包装不低于 35%。同时，所有包装必须具备可回收性设计。这一政策直接推动 rPET 和 rPP 等再生塑料需求激增，倒逼上游石化企业加大 PCR 原料产能，中游包装加工商加速转型采用再生料生产，品牌商则面临合规成本上升与供应链重构压力。澳大利亚 2025 年包装目标及美国 EPA 可持续采购指南亦同步强化再生料比例要求，形成全球协同效应。SGS 等第三方检测机构凭借 GRS/RCS 认证及可回收性评估服务，成为企业合规的关键支撑，提供从标准解读到整改方案的一站式解决方案，助力产业链高效响应政策变革。
items.summaryZh: 随着全球塑料循环经济政策趋严，欧盟于 2030 年 1 月 1 日起实施强制性包装再生料使用标准，要求 PET 接触敏感包装再生料含量不低于 30%，一次性塑料饮料瓶不低于 30%，其他塑料包装不低于 35%。同时，所有包装必须具备可回收性设计。这一政策直接推动 rPET 和 rPP 等再生塑料需求激增，倒逼上游石化企业加大 PCR 原料产能，中游包装加工商加速转型采用再生料生产，品牌商则面临合规成本上升与供应链重构压力。澳大利亚 2025 年包装目标及美国 EPA 可持续采购指南亦同步强化再生料比例要求，形成全球协同效应。SGS 等第三方检测机构凭借 GRS/RCS 认证及可回收性评估服务，成为企业合规的关键支撑，提供从标准解读到整改方案的一站式解决方案，助力产业链高效响应政策变革。
items.summaryEn: As global plastic recycling economy policies tighten, the EU will implement mandatory packaging recycling material usage standards starting January 1, 2030, requiring at least 30% recycled PET content for sensitive packaging, 30% for single-use plastic beverage bottles, and 35% for other plastic packaging. All packaging must also have recyclable design. This policy directly drives a surge in demand for recycled plastics like rPET and rPP, forcing upstream petrochemical companies to increase PCR raw material capacity, midstream packaging processors to accelerate the transition to recycled material production, and brands to face rising compliance costs and supply chain restructuring pressures. Australia's 2025 packaging targets and the U.S. EPA's sustainable procurement guidelines also strengthen recycled material proportion requirements, creating a global synergy effect. Third-party testing institutions like SGS, with GRS/RCS certification and recyclability assessment services, become a key support for corporate compliance, offering one-stop solutions from standard interpretation to rectification plans, helping the industrial chain efficiently respond to policy changes.

items.title: Jeanine Pirro says she has evidence officer was shot at White House press dinner - The Guardian
items.titleZh: 美检方证实特工遭枪击：特朗普遇刺案关键证据浮现
items.titleEn: US evidence confirms Secret Service agent shot in Trump assassination attempt
items.summary: 美国哥伦比亚特区联邦检察官让娜·皮罗（Jeanine Pirro）证实，联邦特工在华盛顿希尔顿酒店举行的白宫记者协会晚宴期间遭嫌疑人射击。核心证据显示，嫌疑人科勒·托马森·艾伦（Cole Tomas Allen）使用的莫茨伯格泵动式霰弹枪发射的铅丸与特工防弹衣纤维纠缠在一起。该案件涉及三项联邦重罪，包括企图刺杀总统。嫌疑人此前在社交媒体上将特朗普比作希特勒，并鼓励持枪反对者。检方指控其携带霰弹枪、.38 口径手枪及刀具从加州乘火车抵达华盛顿，意图在聚集了总统、第一夫人及内阁高官的宴会厅内实施大规模枪击。目前嫌疑人已脱离自杀观察室，检方表示大陪审团即将介入，预计将追加多项指控。此事件凸显了美国高层安保体系的漏洞及极端主义对政治安全的威胁。
items.summaryEn: U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia Jeanine Pirro confirmed that a federal agent was shot during the White House Correspondents' Association dinner at the Washington Hilton. Core evidence shows that the suspect, Cole Tomas Allen, used a Mossberg pump-action shotgun, whose lead pellets became entangled with the agent's bulletproof vest fibers. The case involves three federal felonies, including attempted assassination of the President. The suspect previously compared Trump to Hitler on social media and encouraged gun-wielding opponents. The prosecution charges him with carrying a shotgun, a .38-caliber handgun, and a knife while traveling from California to Washington by train, with the intent to carry out a mass shooting in the banquet hall where the President, First Lady, and cabinet officials were gathered. The suspect has been removed from the suicide observation room, and the prosecution says a grand jury is about to get involved, with additional charges expected. This incident highlights the vulnerabilities in the U.S. high-level security system and the threat of extremism to political security.

items.titleZh: 发改委：2026年起再生塑料企业享受增值税即征即退50%优惠
items.titleEn: NDRC: Plastic Recyclers to Receive 50% VAT Rebate from 2026
items.summary: 国家发展改革委发布通知，自2026年1月1日起，符合条件的再生塑料加工企业可享受增值税即征即退50%的优惠政策，预计惠及全国3,200余家规模以上企业。
items.summaryZh: 国家发展改革委发布通知，自2026年1月1日起，符合条件的再生塑料加工企业可享受增值税即征即退50%的优惠政策，预计惠及全国3,200余家规模以上企业。
items.summaryEn: China's NDRC has announced that qualified plastic recycling processors will receive a 50% VAT rebate starting January 2026, benefiting an estimated 3,200+ above-scale enterprises nationwide.

items.title: PPWR正式生效：欧盟要求2030年PET饮料瓶含30% PCR
items.titleZh: PPWR正式生效：欧盟要求2030年PET饮料瓶含30% PCR
items.titleEn: PPWR Takes Effect: EU Mandates 30% PCR in PET Bottles by 2030
items.summary: 欧盟《包装和包装废弃物法规》（PPWR）关键条款正式生效，要求PET饮料瓶在2030年前须含至少30%消费后再生料（PCR），违规企业将面临最高年营业额4%的罚款。
items.summaryZh: 欧盟《包装和包装废弃物法规》（PPWR）关键条款正式生效，要求PET饮料瓶在2030年前须含至少30%消费后再生料（PCR），违规企业将面临最高年营业额4%的罚款。
items.summaryEn: Key clauses of the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) have entered into force, requiring PET beverage bottles to contain at least 30% PCR by 2030. Non-compliance may incur fines of up to 4% of annual turnover.
